# Code of conduct

[🇵🇱 Polski](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.pl.md)

Adapted from the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

## Our pledge

We want taking part in this project to be a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size,
disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education,
socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion or sexual identity and orientation.

## Expected behavior

- kindness and empathy toward other people;
- respect for differing opinions, viewpoints and experiences;
- giving constructive feedback, and accepting it gracefully;
- taking responsibility for our mistakes and learning from them;
- focusing on what's best for the community, not just for ourselves.

## Unacceptable behavior

- sexualized language or imagery, and unwelcome sexual attention;
- trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, personal or political attacks;
- public or private harassment;
- publishing other people's private information (such as an address or email) without explicit permission;
- other conduct that could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may remove, edit or reject comments, commits, code, issues and other contributions that don't
follow this code of conduct, and in serious or repeated cases block a person from the repository.

Report unacceptable behavior with the **Report content** button next to the content on GitHub, or directly to the
project maintainer. Every report will be reviewed, and the reporter's identity will be kept confidential.

## Scope

This code of conduct applies in all project spaces – issues, pull requests, discussions and code reviews – and
whenever someone officially represents the project outside of them.
